faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about getting started with MaiAI.

0.question: Does MaiAI replace my current booking system?
0.answer: It can, but it doesn't have to! MaiAI can act as your complete all-in-one CRM and booking system, or it can integrate as a smart layer on top of popular systems like Square, Mindbody, or Phorest.

1.question: How hard is it to train the AI on my salon's rules?
1.answer: Not hard at all. Our onboarding process involves a simple interview where we ask about your services, timing, staff skills, and preferences. MaiAI learns from this and handles complex scenarios—like requiring extra time for removal before a new set—automatically.

2.question: Can clients still call to book?
2.answer: Absolutely! MaiAI answers phone calls naturally and books appointments just like a human receptionist would. Clients can also text or use your website—whatever they prefer.

3.question: Is client data secure?
3.answer: Yes. We use enterprise-grade encryption, comply with all data protection regulations, and never share your client information with third parties. Your data stays yours.
